state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`: Stages 9 to 11 are done, and Stage 12 (`no Python`) is under way.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv audit python` (`tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts`) is Stage 12's check, and its output is the list still to clear: 13 `.py` files and 140 documents. Two calls it makes, which the user may overrule: the Python twins under `benches/userland/` are not tools, because `bun nv bench` runs them as the Python engine's workload, so they stay; and a "document" is tracked Markdown outside `docs/decisions/`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the prose of every goal the chain has reached. The module doc owns the definition.

The import cluster is deleted: `brief`, `chain`, `context-sync`, `goal-switch`, `goals`, `loop-stats`, `orient`, `owners`, `plan`, `playbook`, `proof`, `records`, `rules` and `side`. Their parity groups are gone, and the playbook importer reads section records under `data/playbook/`. The `[until:]` trailer syntax now lives in `tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts`'s module doc. `bun nv rules --render` is the command stamped into every generated chapter. Three tools were deleted with no port, because Stage 12 deletes every `.py`. `proof.py` (the blind-reader test of `docs/novis.md`) and `side.py` (side runs, so no side goal can run) have no replacement. Neither does the unscoped part of `brief.py`, and `bun nv orient --full` is the nearest.

`bun nv links` reports 6 `retired` findings, all in the prose of `tools/disk.py`, `tools/observe.py` and `tools/peek.py`, and they go with those files. `bun nv import --check` throws a stack trace (not investigated). `bun nv parity disk` differs on every run, so `tools/disk.py` stays until that is explained.
